nodes.description: Public constant string state variable 'Asset' declaring the adapter type.
Public constant string state variable 'ERC20' declaring the token type.
Internal constant address of the TokenController contract (0x5407381b6c251cFd498ccD4A1d877739CB7960B8) used for external calls.
Internal constant address of the NXM ERC20 token (0xd7c49CEE7E9188cCa6AD8FF264C1DA2e69D4Cf3B) used for external calls.
External view function implementing ProtocolAdapter.getBalance; reads total balance from TokenController and token balance of NXM, returns the difference.
Named address parameter 'account' of getBalance, used as argument to external calls.
Local variable holding the result of TokenController.totalBalanceOf(account).
Local variable holding the result of ERC20(NXM).balanceOf(account).
Unchecked unsigned subtraction totalBalance - tokenBalance in Solidity 0.6.5, can underflow if tokenBalance exceeds totalBalance.

edges.reason: TOKEN_CONTROLLER constant address is used by getBalance to perform the external totalBalanceOf call.
NXM constant address is used by getBalance to perform the external ERC20 balanceOf call.
The account parameter flows into the TokenController.totalBalanceOf call whose result is stored in totalBalance.
The account parameter flows into the ERC20(NXM).balanceOf call whose result is stored in tokenBalance.
totalBalance is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction, enabling arithmetic underflow.
tokenBalance is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction, enabling arithmetic underflow.
getBalance executes the unchecked subtraction on externally supplied balances before returning the result.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter is only meaningful as the caller-supplied argument consumed by the getBalance function via its external calls.
totalBalance exists solely as the minuend operand of the unchecked subtraction in getBalance.
tokenBalance exists solely as the subtrahend operand of the unchecked subtraction in getBalance.
